description_en: Call CreateSlrRole to create a service-linked role for Data Security Center (DSC). This role authorizes DSC to access your cloud resources
description_zh: 调用CreateSlrRole创建数据安全中心DSC（Data Security Center）的服务关联角色，授权DSC访问云资源
kebab_example: aliyun sddp create-slr-role --source-ip 106.11.XX.XX --feature-type 2 --lang zh_cn --service-name example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSlrRole

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response messages. Default value: zh_cn. Valid values:

zh_cn: Chinese (Simplified)

en_us: English (US)
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh_cn。取值：
zh_cn：中文（简体）
en_us：英文（美国）
parameters.name: lang

HasPermission.description_en:
Indicates whether the service-linked role was created successfully. Valid values:

true: Success

false: Failure
HasPermission.description_zh:
服务关联角色是否创建成功。取值：
true：成功
false：失败

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
